simple.meaning: בַּת (bath) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a bath or Hebrew measure (as a means of division ) of liquids.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 13 times across 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Isaiah, Ezekiel, beginning at 1 Kings 7:26. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בַּת (H1324).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: a bath or Hebrew measure (as a means of division ) of liquids
definitions.full: H1324. bath II. בַּת bath (a measure), בָּתָה see below בתת . II. בַּת noun masculine Ezek 45:14 ( feminine Isa 5:10 ) bath (Thes and others from above √ in sense of define, measure ; compare τέμνω ; Lag Or. ii. 10 f. makes = בדת , = בד + feminine ת ; compare Syriac , instrument for pressing olives; compare Epiphanius βάδος = ἐλαιοτριβεῖον ; & βάδος also Hesychius Jos Ant. viii. 2 . 9 but ed. Niese βάτους , βάτος — ׳בּ absolute 5:10 6 t.; ( בָּ֑ת Ezek 45:11 ) construct 45:10 ; plural בַּתִּים 2Chr 2:9 (twice in verse) + 3t.; — a liquid measure = אֵיפָה of dry measure, each being 1/10 חֹמֶר (q. v.) Ezek 45:11 (twice in verse); 45:14 (twice in verse); also Isa 5:10 ; 1Kin 7:26 , 38 ; 2Chr 2:9 (twice in verse); 4:5 + Ezek 45:14 (twice in verse) (4 t. in this see, Co strike out a & d ). 45:10 בַּתצֶֿדֶק a righteous (right, accurate, full) bath (|| אֵיפַתצֶֿדֶק ).
